name: BASIRA Core 1.0 public smoke stays healthy without mutating data

planSteps.description: Open /login on the configured BASIRA target. Do not submit valid credentials and do not create, update, publish, enroll, upload, or delete any data.

Verify the Arabic RTL login experience renders successfully with the BASIRA name بصيرة, the heading مرحبًا بعودتك, an access-code field, and a دخول button, without a fatal server error or broken critical layout.
Open /api/health?deep=1 on the same BASIRA deployment.
Verify the health response reports ok=true, backend=supabase, and database=ready.
Open the protected route /app/student while unauthenticated.
Verify protected student content is not exposed and the visitor is returned to the login experience or otherwise denied access safely.
Return to /login and inspect the page at both desktop and mobile-sized viewports without entering a valid access code.
Verify the login experience remains usable, Arabic-first, RTL, and free of obvious horizontal overflow, missing critical controls, or fatal rendering errors.
